title: Inference Practice 1
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Extra Charger

Before a long meeting, Damon placed his laptop charger in his backpack and added a second charger. At the meeting room, he offered the extra one to a teammate whose battery warning had appeared.

TEXT B - Marked Map

A trail guide circled two bridges on a paper map and wrote "check after rain" beside both. After a storm, she visited those locations before inspecting the rest of the trail.

TEXT C - Priority Note

A desk note lists "call supplier," "finish poster," and "check room booking." The room-booking item is underlined twice. Five minutes later, Maya opens the booking website before touching the other tasks.

TEXT D - Window Seat

When the bus became crowded, Eli moved his bag from the seat beside him to the floor before anyone asked. He then shifted closer to the window and looked toward the aisle.
